description: This file contains unit tests for the PIMLeftMenuService class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests menu item retrieval, caching behavior, and access permissions related to the PIM (Personnel Information Management) module.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the PIMLeftMenuService class including menu access, caching, and permission checks.

methods.name: getAllMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to mock the retrieval of all menu items with optional tax menu enabled status.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsAllMenusAccessible
methods.description: Test case verifying that all menus are accessible when permissions are granted.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsOnlyDependentsAccessible
methods.description: Test case verifying that only the Dependents menu is accessible when permissions are limited.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployee
methods.description: Test clearing the menu cache for a single employee.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployeeNotCached
methods.description: Test clearing cache when no cache exists for the specified employee.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuAll
methods.description: Test clearing the cache for all employees.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleTrue
methods.description: Test PIM module accessibility when full permissions are granted.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleFalse
methods.description: Test PIM module inaccessibility when permissions are denied.
